_comment: The gates of the study, in order. A fork edits this file to change them. `article` is the folder under articles/ a gate accepts (for a family gate, the prefix: the folder is chosen when the gate opens). `after` lists the gates that must have passed or been skipped. `understand` says whether the gate has the /understand check. `skippable` says whether `gate.py skip` is allowed.

gates.title: Definition
gates.unlocks: write scope.md from the definition (/definition scope), then gather and convert papers; create the map (/new-article map)

gates.title: Map
gates.unlocks: the survey: process papers and dossiers in the depth the map proposed; create the review (/new-article review)

gates.title: Survey
gates.unlocks: requirements version 1 (/new-article requirements), or the concept stage (/new-article rationale)

gates.title: Concept
gates.unlocks: the specification of the chosen concept (/new-article specification <name>)

gates.title: Split
gates.unlocks: the clean implementation repo; later specifications join by a recorded amendment
